    <div class="pr-hero-content">
      <div class="pr-breadcrumb pr-anim pr-d1">
        <a href="https://www.margarita-village.com/">Home</a><span>/</span>

        Prices & Rates
      </div>
      <span class="pr-eyebrow-hero pr-anim pr-d1">Kalpitiya · Sri Lanka</span>
      <h1 class="pr-anim pr-d2">Prices & Rates —<br /><em>Margarita Village</em></h1>
      <p class="pr-hero-sub pr-anim pr-d3">Transparent pricing for your kitesurfing holiday in Kalpitiya. Bungalows, meals, bikes, yoga and everything included in your stay — no surprises.</p>  
      <div class="pr-hero-ctas pr-anim pr-d4">
        <a href="#pr-bungalows" class="pr-btn pr-btn-gold">See Bungalow Rates</a>
        <a href="#pr-kite-wing-rates" class="pr-btn pr-btn-ghost">Kitesurfing & wingfoiling rates</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  
  <section class="pr-rates" id="pr-bungalows">
    <div class="pr-rates-inner">
      <div class="pr-section-header pr-reveal">
        <span class="pr-eyebrow" style="color:var(--gold);">Accommodation</span>
        <h2>Bungalow Rates — Bed & Breakfast</h2>
        <p>One bungalow type, three occupancy options. All rates are per person per night and include bed & breakfast.</p>  
      </div>

      <div class="pr-occ-grid">

        <div class="pr-occ-card pr-reveal">
          <div class="pr-occ-icon">
            <svg></svg>
          </div>
          <div class="pr-occ-type">Single Occupancy</div>
          <div class="pr-occ-sub">1 person in the bungalow</div>
          <div class="pr-occ-price">
            <span class="currency">€</span><span class="amount">45</span>
            <span class="period">per person / night · B&B</span>
          </div>
          <p>Ideal for solo travellers who want their own space — and Kalpitiya is one of the best solo destinations in Sri Lanka.</p>  
        </div>

        <div class="pr-occ-card featured pr-reveal">
          <div class="pr-occ-badge">Most popular</div>
          <div class="pr-occ-icon">
            <svg></svg>
          </div>
          <div class="pr-occ-type">Double Occupancy</div>
          <div class="pr-occ-sub">2 people sharing</div>
          <div class="pr-occ-price">

        <h2>FAQ — Prices & Booking</h2>
        <p>Common questions about rates, what is included and how to book.</p>  
      </div>

      <div class="pr-faq-item">
        <button class="pr-faq-q" onclick="prFaq(this)">What is the price of a kitesurfing holiday in Kalpitiya?<span class="pr-faq-icon">+</span></button>
        <div class="pr-faq-a">At Margarita Village, accommodation starts at <strong>18€ per person per night</strong> (triple occupancy, B&B) and goes up to 45€ (single). Add kite lessons from 270€ at <a href="https://www.margaritakiteschool.com/kite-school-in-sri-lanka/" target="_blank">Margarita Kite School</a>, meals from 5.50€ and you have one of the best value kitesurfing holidays in Asia. A week's stay for two people sharing a bungalow works out at around 280€ total for accommodation including breakfast.</div>
      </div>

      <div class="pr-faq-item">
        <button class="pr-faq-q" onclick="prFaq(this)">Is breakfast included in the price?<span class="pr-faq-icon">+</span></button>
        <div class="pr-faq-a">Yes — all bungalow rates are bed & breakfast. When you book directly with us, the rate also includes boat transfers to the lagoon, equipment storage and safety rescue. These are <strong>not included</strong> if you book via Booking.com, Airbnb or Agoda.</div>
      </div>

      <div class="pr-faq-item">
        <button class="pr-faq-q" onclick="prFaq(this)">Why should I book directly instead of via Booking.com?<span class="pr-faq-icon">+</span></button>
        <div class="pr-faq-a">Direct booking always includes boat transfers (5€/day via OTAs), equipment storage (5€/day) and safety rescue (10€/rescue) — services that add up quickly over a week. You also get a more personal experience, the option to ask questions before you arrive, and access to our <strong>combined special rates when booking kite lessons</strong> alongside accommodation.</div>
      </div>

      <div class="pr-faq-item">
        <button class="pr-faq-q" onclick="prFaq(this)">How much does kitesurfing cost in Kalpitiya?<span class="pr-faq-icon">+</span></button>
        <div class="pr-faq-a">Kite lessons and courses are managed by <a href="https://www.margaritakiteschool.com/kite-school-in-sri-lanka/" target="_blank">Margarita Kite School</a> — prices start from 270€ for a full IKO beginner course. Equipment rental and advanced coaching are also available. See the kite school website for full pricing. If you book accommodation and lessons together, ask us about combined rates.</div>
      </div>

      <div class="pr-faq-item">
        <button class="pr-faq-q" onclick="prFaq(this)">Are there minimum stay requirements?<span class="pr-faq-icon">+</span></button>
        <div class="pr-faq-a">There is no strict minimum, but we recommend at least <strong>5–7 nights</strong> to make the most of your kitesurfing holiday in Kalpitiya. The wind is not guaranteed every day, so a longer stay ensures you get quality time on the water — plus you need time for dolphin watching, yoga, exploring and all the <a href="https://www.margarita-village.com/things-to-do-in-kalpitiya/">things to do in Kalpitiya</a>.</div>
      </div>

      <div class="pr-faq-item">

You can also use our <a href="https://www.margarita-village.com/contact/">contact form</a>. We reply within 24 hours and will confirm availability and any special rates for you.</div>
